feature.summary: In the web visual editor, a toolbar sets text style (normal, heading 1 to 6, code block) and applies bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, links, lists, checklists, quotes and code blocks. Underline, alignment, spacing, indentation and callouts do not exist. Math shows in the reader view only.

purpose.what_it_does: Lets the person style text and insert blocks in a document, and renders code and math in the reader view.
purpose.why_it_exists: Documents need structure and emphasis, and people expect buttons instead of Markdown marks.
purpose.who_uses_it: Web users editing documents; readers of documents on all apps that render Markdown.
problems_solved: Making a heading or list without typing marks.
Safe links that cannot run scripts.
use_cases: Make a checklist for a task list.
Add a link to a source.

where_to_find_it: Web: the toolbar named 'Formatting' above the visual editor (DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx:117-122).
Web source mode: keyboard shortcuts Cmd or Ctrl plus B, I and K wrap the selection (ArtifactPreview.tsx:387-393).
Reader view on web and shared Markdown renderer elsewhere: code and math display (MarkdownContent.tsx).
Mobile: source text box only (ArtifactFullScreen.tsx:2016). Others: none.
prerequisites: The visual editor is open (see F027-03).
screens_and_controls: Dropdown 'Text style': Normal text, Heading 1 to 6, Code block.
Buttons: Bold, Italic, Strikethrough, Inline code, Link, Bulleted list, Numbered list, Checklist, Quote, Code block, Insert table, Undo, Redo.
Link form: box 'Link address' (hidden label) with placeholder 'Paste or type a link', buttons Apply and Remove link.
journey: Select text or place the cursor.
Pick a style or click a button.
For a link, click Link, type an address, click Apply.
feedback_and_outputs: Active styles show as pressed buttons.
Shortcut hints in tooltips: bold and italic (Cmd or Ctrl plus B and I), code block (Cmd or Ctrl plus Alt plus C), undo and redo (DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx:152-186,215-216,255-268).

working: Heading levels 1 to 6, paragraph and code block via dropdown (DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx:99-101,135-147).
Bold, italic, strike, inline code toggles (lines 148-178).
Link accepts only http, https and mailto; a bare address gets https (lines 33-43).
Bulleted, numbered, task list, blockquote and code block (lines 193-215).
Reader view renders task lists with clickable boxes and math through markdown-it plugins (taskList.ts:34-40; markdownItMath.ts exists).

disconnected_or_disabled: Underline switched off (document-editor-markdown.ts:11). The brief marks S27.06 done including underline, which the code contradicts.
not_available: Alignment, spacing, indentation controls: none found.
Any formatting controls on mobile, Chrome, CLI and VS Code for documents.

corrections.claim: Link accepts only http, https and mailto; a bare address gets https (lines 33-43)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: safeHref (DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx:32-42) only prepends https:// when the text does not start with a scheme-like token (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/). So 'example.com:8080' or 'localhost:3000' is read as a scheme, fails the protocol check and is silently dropped. Plain 'example.com' does become https://example.com/. Lines are off by one.
corrections.correction: A bare address without a scheme-like prefix gets https. An address with host:port is treated as a scheme and rejected without a message.

corrections.claim: Reader view renders task lists with clickable boxes and math through markdown-it plugins (taskList.ts:34-40; markdownItMath.ts exists)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The reader (MarkdownContent) uses remark-math, not markdown-it. taskList.ts:34-40 is taskIndexAtOffset, a helper that finds a task index, and it does not render boxes. markdownItMath.ts is imported by the Chrome side panel and the VS Code webview, not by the web reader.
corrections.correction: The web reader renders math through remark-math (remarkPlugins.ts:73). taskList.ts supplies the helpers that find and toggle checklist markers. markdownItMath.ts serves the Chrome side panel and the VS Code webview.

corrections.claim: Math is shown but cannot be edited visually; such documents open as source (document-editor-markdown.ts:19)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The behaviour is right but the citation is not. MATH_SPAN is defined at line 16 and used in roundTripsAsDocument at line 82. ArtifactDocumentEditor.tsx:56 calls it to choose source mode. The same check also sends any document that fails the Markdown round trip to source, not only math. SlideTextEditor.tsx:83 uses it too.
corrections.correction: Documents with math, or any content that does not round-trip through the Tiptap Markdown parser, open as source (roundTripsAsDocument, document-editor-markdown.ts:81-90).

corrections.claim: Draft in localStorage until saved, then the artifacts store (ArtifactPreview.tsx:395,1130-1139)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Line 395 is the ARTIFACT_DRAFT_STORAGE_PREFIX constant. The localStorage helpers are at lines 406-427 and wrap every access in try/catch. When storage is blocked, writeStoredDraft returns false and the draft is not kept. Lines 1130-1139 do upsert to useArtifactsStore. The page does not say sync happens elsewhere.
corrections.correction: The draft is held in localStorage (key agi.artifact-draft:<id>) when storage is available and is removed after it is committed to the in-memory artifacts store. If storage is blocked, the draft is not persisted.

corrections.claim: Permissions: Editing only on the latest stored version.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: canEditSource requires variant==='panel', a stored artifact, the latest version, and not PDF, DOCX or image. The page omits the panel-only condition and the file-type exclusions.
corrections.correction: Editing is offered only in the panel variant, for a stored artifact, on the latest version, and never for PDF, DOCX or image artifacts.

corrections.claim: Escape in link box closes the box (226-232); table button disabled in table (219); toolbar scrolls sideways (123); mousedown prevented (57)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The behaviours exist, but all four line cites are wrong. Escape is at 247-251. The disabled table button is at 215. overflow-x-auto is at 129. onMouseDown preventDefault is at 62.
corrections.correction: Escape: :247-251. Table disabled: :215. Overflow scroll: :129. Mousedown: :62.

missing_facts: The same Tiptap editor and roundTripsAsDocument gate are also used by the slide text editor, so slide text gets the same formatting rules (apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts/presentation/SlideTextEditor.tsx:12,83).

Source-mode Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and K wrap with ** , _ and [text](https://), and are wired for documents at ArtifactPreview.tsx:3295 and 3339. The K link shortcut inserts an unchecked https:// placeholder and bypasses safeHref.

The Chrome side panel and the VS Code webview both render math through markdownItMath (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/markdown.ts, apps/extension-vscode/src/webview/render.ts). The page says math shows in the reader view only and marks VS Code as n/a.
